newsitem.title: USA: IMC Global says will call to redeem notes.
newsitem.headline: IMC Global says will call to redeem notes.

text.p: IMC Global Inc said on Wednesday it will call for redemption on November 15, 1996, all of its outstanding 6-1/4 percent convertible subordinated notes due 2001.

As of September 30, about $114.9 million of these notes were outstanding. IMC said it would realize annual pretax interest savings of about $7.2 million if all holders choose to convert their notes into shares of IMC Global common stock.
"This is another step forward in strengthening our capital structure and further expanding our financial flexibility," said chief executive Wendell Bueche.
